# apivel Technical Documentation & LLM Gateway

> apivel (https://apivel.com) provides enterprise-grade, low-latency API routing gateways connecting global developers to frontier foundation models (DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3.8 Max, GLM-5.3, MiniMax H3, Kimi K3) via native OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible protocols with zero KYC, instant PayPal checkout, and 0% foreign transaction fees.

## Core Model & Persistent Agent Guides
- [REA in Claude Code: Fix Tool Limits & Cut Token Costs](https://apivel.com/blog/claude-code-rea-setup-limits-cost/): Comprehensive engineering guide to resolving "claude reached its tool-use limit for this turn" and "max length for this message" in REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP reverse engineering. Explains Ghidra pointer recursion limits, context budgeting, and cutting token expenses by 85% to 95% with DeepSeek V4 and Qwen 3.8 Max via apivel.
- [DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 API Setup & Limits Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-api-setup/): Technical integration reference for the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 MoE snapshot. Covers 552B parameter size vs local GPU VRAM realities, DeepSWE 77.0 benchmarks, tool-calling schema drift mitigation above 125k context, official 503 error failover routing, and wholesale token pricing ($0.14 input / $0.28 output per 1M tokens) with zero-KYC PayPal checkout and $0.20 free signup credits.
- [MiniMax M3.1 Flash Benchmarks, Size & API Setup Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/minimax-m3-flash-api-setup-benchmark/): Comprehensive benchmark analysis and integration tutorial for MiniMax M3.1 Flash (428B MoE / 23B active, 1M context, 73.7% DeepSWE v1.1). Covers Claude Code and Cursor integration with instant PayPal checkout and $0.20 free signup credits.
- [Qwen 4 Release Date, 27B Roadmap & API Setup Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/qwen-4-release-date-api-roadmap/): Authoritative roadmap and tracking guide for Alibaba's Qwen 4 frontier generation. Covers Apsara conference announcements, Reddit r/LocalLLaMA leaks, Polymarket prediction odds, 27B open weights for 24GB VRAM local rigs, HyperConnection and QSA architecture, and zero-KYC PayPal API integration for Cursor and Claude Code.
- [Claude Opus 5.5 Price, Limits & Claude Code Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/claude-opus-5-5-price-limits-claude-code/): Complete pricing mechanics, benchmark analysis, and setup guide for Anthropic's flagship Claude Opus 5.5. Covers mandatory adaptive thinking token cost dynamics, resolving Claude Code weekly subscription rate limit freezes, multi-model failover architectures (Opus 5.5 + Sonnet 5.5 + Qwen 3.7 Max), and zero-KYC PayPal billing with $0.20 free signup trial.
- [9Router vs OmniRoute: Best Claude Alternatives](https://apivel.com/blog/9router-vs-omniroute-alternatives-guide/): Complete architectural breakdown and benchmark comparing 9Router local NPM proxy vs OmniRoute vs official production gateways. Covers resolving Windows port 20128 collisions, mitigating Anthropic OAuth session 403 ban risks, RTK context compression tradeoffs, and direct low-latency routing to Qwen 3.7 Max and DeepSeek V4 with instant PayPal checkout.
- [Kimi K3.1 Pro Pricing, Benchmarks & API Access Guide](https://apivel.com/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro-pricing-benchmarks-api-access/): Complete review, benchmark analysis, and integration guide for Moonshot AI's flagship 2.8T MoE model (104B active, 1M context, 65.7% Terminal-Bench 4.0). Covers Claude Code and Cursor integration, bypassing mainland KYC and 5-hour rate limits, and instant zero-KYC PayPal checkout with $0.20 free signup credits.
- [Ponytail GitHub Skill: Setup, Review & Costs](https://apivel.com/blog/ponytail-github-skill-install-review/): Complete engineering reference and benchmark review for the DietrichGebert/ponytail YAGNI prompt framework. Covers multi-platform installation across Claude Code CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, and Copilot, mitigating the "dangerously lazy" edge-case, and compounding Ponytail's ~21% token waste reduction with Qwen 3.7 Max and DeepSeek V4 wholesale pricing via APIVALE's Anthropic-compatible gateway for over 85% total compute savings with instant PayPal checkout.
